skills.name: Hacking
skills.description: Sits down and attempts to hack. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Use Rate +40%  (7 sec) *HP x 40% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

skills.name: Kengo Cooperation
skills.description: Kengo, who was summoned, creates clones and attacks enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Stuns enemies (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -60% (7 sec) *ATK x 4600% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: Yozakura
abilities.description: Yozakura Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Ally Clone+
abilities.description: Has a high chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy. - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
